# Developer Onboarding Guide

Welcome to the Manufacturing CRM UI Mockups repository!

## Getting Started
- Clone the repository
- Open in Visual Studio or VS Code
- All mockups are in `/WebApi/UI_MOCKUPS/`
- Main menu: `/WebApi/UI_MOCKUPS/MainMenu/index.html`

## Structure
- Each feature has its own subfolder with HTML and API MD files
- Documentation is in `/WebApi/UI_MOCKUPS/00_Documentation/`

## How to Use
- Open any HTML file in your browser for a static mockup
- Refer to the matching `.md` for API details
- Use the main menu for navigation and demo

## Contribution
- Add new features in a new subfolder
- Follow the UI/UX guidelines
- Update the API master list as needed
